Fractional silver coins carry 15-130% higher premiums per ounce than full-ounce products, depending on size. The silver quality is identical at .999 fine. New buyers should build a base position in 1 oz products first before adding fractional sizes. Full analysis: https://fuseddistribution.com/blog/fractional-silver-coins/
